digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler bridge exit code adapter
propositions: Canonical preview and sync routes must emit only exit codes 0/1/2 while legacy reconcile CLI and direct-engine routes retain historical 3/4/75 translations for backward compatibility.

A single typed disposition is consumed by both canonical and legacy adapters; canonical routes map to 0/1/2 and legacy routes translate the same dispositions to 3/4/75 with preserved messages and defaults.

Production workflows using the canonical route operate only on 0/1/2 with no numeric whitelist, while older checked-out workflows, systemd units, Jenkins jobs, and scripts continue to consume legacy 3/4/75 without modification.
All benign states (converged, paused, in-flight, reschedule, phase-gate) must map to exit 0 in canonical mode; invalid invocation/configuration to 2; and operational failure to 1.
